## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Dynamic pool models → Length-based age-structured |
| **Method name** | Statistical catch-at-length |
| **Short description** | Statistical catch-at-length models that fit catch, indices and length compositions with a size-structured population model (e.g. a4a, Stock Synthesis configurations). |
| **Main outputs** | Dynamic size-structured status |
| **Typical use case** | Catch + index + length composition |

::: {.callout-tip}
